title: Management requests
description: Changes to Management-owned slices (roster, economy, contracts, reputation, unlocks) requested by the strategic layer: contract offers, player services at a location, op returns, plant output, the daily rollover and reputation-relevant strategic acts. Management validates and applies each one and returns a result per request; it publishes the resulting state in management_view (MGT-072). Spec: STR-004, STR-015, STR-029, STR-039..STR-044, STR-093, MGT-001, MGT-002..MGT-005, MGT-011, MGT-039..MGT-051, MGT-056..MGT-060, MGT-064, MGT-068, MGT-070.

results.description: Management's answer, one per request. acceptContract and missionOutcome return paymentDue; Strategic deducts it from the employer's funds and sends contractPayment, only then Management credits the player (STR-093, MGT-047).

offer.description: contractOffer: the offer to store in contracts with status offered (STR-044, MGT-041, MGT-042)

reason.description: contractEnded; employerDefault = advance kept, no debt (MGT-048)

employer.description: contractPayment: the faction whose funds paid (STR-093)

location.description: Region or POI where it happens

fate.description: soldierFate: the final status of the listed soldiers who did not reach an FOB (MGT-011); battle_result leftMap stays active (MGT-001)

act.description: reputationAct: the act, named by its management-rules repActs key (MGT-056..MGT-060)

plantId.description: plantOutput: the held plant POI that delivers (STR-015, MGT-068)

contractOffer.description: Local copy of strategic_commands.schema.json $defs/contractOffer (0.5.0); keep the two identical (no cross-file refs, shared/schema.js).

id.description: Offer ID, unique per campaign; acceptContract.contractId and MGT refer to it

targetFaction.description: The faction the missions act against, if any (reputation acts, MGT-056)

sourceGoal.description: The STR-018 goal the offer serves (MGT-043)

key.description: Per-mission key, unique within the offer (two missions of one type are told apart by it)

reputationGain.description: Reputation with the employer on success (MGT-056)

reputationGate.description: MGT-055 contract flags set by the offering faction: better = Friendly or better only, sensitive = Trusted only
